about: Per-district facts computed from the baked rasters, the baked DEM, the district boundaries and the 2026 DLRRD notice review. Grid statistics count cells whose centre falls inside the district; nodata cells are excluded and null means the layer recorded nothing there. Notice and parcel counts describe what that review found, not every advert or parcel of state land.

boundaries.method: Downloaded and cached by scripts/build-topo.mjs, simplified to a 5% retained-point share and quantised into src/data/sa-districts.topo.json; 2015 names updated to current official municipal names there

coverage.scope: All 53 linked 2026 PDFs on this index were read for Northern Cape coverage. Fifteen NC notices were found; all had passed deadlines. Other years, municipalities and unadvertised state land are outside this review.

areaKm2.method: Spherical excess area (d3-geo geoArea) × (6371.0088 km)², on the simplified boundaries of src/data/sa-districts.topo.json

rain.licence: Public domain (Creative Commons CC0 waiver by Pete Peterson)
rain.method: Grid cells whose centre falls inside the district boundary (even-odd point-in-polygon over every ring); nodata cells excluded; mean and 10th / 90th percentiles (linear interpolation) across the district's valid cells; ocean cells are nodata in this layer

landCover.resolution: 10 m native, mode-resampled to the grid
landCover.method: Grid cells whose centre falls inside the district boundary (even-odd point-in-polygon over every ring); nodata cells excluded; share per class over the classes present, so the shares of one district sum to 1; class labels are in the legend of public/data/layers/landcover.json

soilPh.resolution: 250 m native, depth-weighted to the grid
soilPh.method: Grid cells whose centre falls inside the district boundary (even-odd point-in-polygon over every ring); nodata cells excluded; the source has genuine gaps (parts of Johannesburg), which count as nodata, not as neutral pH

soilClay.resolution: 250 m native, depth-weighted to the grid
soilClay.method: Grid cells whose centre falls inside the district boundary (even-odd point-in-polygon over every ring); nodata cells excluded; percent is the layer's g/kg ÷ 10, the conversion its own units state

elevation.source: Mapzen / USGS / SRTM via AWS Terrain Tiles (the baked DEM)
elevation.method: Grid cells whose centre falls inside the district boundary (even-odd point-in-polygon over every ring); nodata cells excluded, on the 720×560 DEM grid; mean/min/max in metres above sea level; the baked DEM stores ocean as 0 m, so a coastal district's minimum can be 0

notices.method: Notices in src/content/farm-notices.ts counted by their district label; a notice spanning two districts counts once in each; 1 notice(s) read "District awaiting confirmation" and count nowhere

parcels.method: Reference points of the exactly matched parcels in src/data/notice-parcels.json tested against district boundaries. Matching cadastral identifiers, farm names, province and portions. Reference points intersected with the bundled district boundaries. These points are used only for district grouping, not as verified lease locations. Aasvogelpan excluded because its area differs substantially.
